mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS id, m.metadata_field_id AS metadataFieldId, COALESCE(mf.field_name, '用户ID') AS fieldName, COALESCE(mf.field_code, 'id') AS fieldCode, m.app_field_name AS appFieldName, m.app_field_code AS appFieldCode, m.transform_type AS transformType, m.transform_value AS transformValue FROM tab_app_userinfo_field_mapping m LEFT JOIN tab_metadata_field mf ON mf.id = m.metadata_field_id WHERE m.app_id = #{appRefId} ORDER BY m.id ASC
